source_refs.note: Exercise 10.1, Question 4: book page 278 (Q1-Q24). The book prints no answers for Exercise 10.1.

blocks.explanation:
Is equation mein \(\csc^{2}x\) hai. Cosecant ki values zabani yaad nahin hotin, is liye isay sine mein badlenge.
Diya kya hai? \(9 - 3\csc^{2}x = 5\).
Find kya karna hai? Principal solutions aur general solution.
Rule: \(\sin x = \frac{1}{\csc x}\), aur square root ke saath \(\pm\).
Plan: \(\csc^{2}x\) akela karo, sine mein badlo, do cases hal karo, aakhir mein check karo ke \(\csc x\) defined hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(9 - 3\csc^{2}x = 5\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\csc^{2}x\) ko akela karenge, \(\sin x = \frac{1}{\csc x}\) se sine mein badlenge, square root lenge aur do basic sine equations hal karenge.

\(\csc^{2}x\) ko akela karein
\[3\csc^{2}x = 9 - 5 = 4\]
\[\csc^{2}x = \dfrac{4}{3}\]
Kyun: \(3\csc^{2}x\) ko right side aur 5 ko left side le gaye (side badalne par sign badalta hai), phir 3 se divide kiya.

Sine mein badlein
\[\sin^{2}x = \dfrac{3}{4}\]
\[\sin x = \pm\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sin x\) aur \(\csc x\) ek doosre ke ulte (reciprocal) hain, is liye \(\sin^{2}x\) bhi \(\frac{4}{3}\) ka ulta \(\frac{3}{4}\) hai. Square root lete waqt \(\pm\), aur \(\sqrt{4} = 2\).

Jab \(\sin x = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) (quadrant I, II)
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{3}\]
\[x = \pi - \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{2\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: sine positive hai, aur sine upar wale quadrants I aur II mein positive hota hai.

Jab \(\sin x = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) (quadrant III, IV)
\[x = \pi + \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{4\pi}{3}\]
\[x = 2\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{5\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: sine negative ho to point circle ke neeche wale hisse mein hota hai: quadrant III (\(\pi + \alpha\)) aur IV (\(2\pi - \alpha\)).

Kya \(\csc x\) defined hai?
In chaaron angles par \(\sin x \ne 0\), is liye \(\csc x\) mojood hai aur chaaron jawab theek hain.
Kyun: \(\csc x = \frac{1}{\sin x}\) sirf wahan undefined hota hai jahan \(\sin x = 0\) (zero se divide nahin kar sakte). Aise sawalon mein yeh check hamesha kar lein.

General solution
\(\sin x\) ka period \(2\pi\) hai:
\[\left\{\dfrac{\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{2\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{4\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{5\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: har principal solution apni family banata hai; chaaron families ka union poora jawab hai.

Tasdeeq
Chaaron angles par \(\sin^{2}x = \frac{3}{4}\), is liye
\[\csc^{2}x = \dfrac{4}{3}\]
\[9 - 3 \cdot \dfrac{4}{3} = 9 - 4 = 5\]
Kyun: left side right side ke barabar aa gayi. Chhoti shakal bhi yaad rakhein: \(\frac{4\pi}{3} = \frac{\pi}{3} + \pi\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{3} = \frac{2\pi}{3} + \pi\), is liye jawab \(\frac{\pi}{3} + n\pi\) aur \(\frac{2\pi}{3} + n\pi\) bhi likha ja sakta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(x = \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{4\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{3}\). General solution: \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{2\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{4\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{5\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\). (Chhoti shakal: \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{3} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{2\pi}{3} + n\pi\right\}\), kyunke \(\frac{4\pi}{3} = \frac{\pi}{3} + \pi\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{3} = \frac{2\pi}{3} + \pi\).)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
